about: Forced-decoding log probabilities of the existing English translations given the Korean source. Made by explanations/logprob_heatmap/generate.py; see METHOD.md. Offsets are character offsets into english.<version> in notices.json; text is always text[start:end].

settings.prompt:
Translate the following Korean notice into English. Reply with the translation only.

{korean}
settings.word_logprob: min over the word's tokens (punctuation at the word's edges ignored)
settings.confidence: exp(word logprob), i.e. the probability of the word's weakest token

contrast.prompt_nosrc: Write a notice in English. Reply with the notice only.
contrast.pmi: token logprob given the source minus logprob given the source-free prompt
contrast.confidence_contrast: exp(min(0, min pmi over the word's tokens)); 1 = the source does not make the word less likely

settings.rendered_prompt_example:
<bos><|turn>user
Write a notice in English. Reply with the notice only.<turn|>
<|turn>model
<|channel>thought
<channel|>

correct.text:
This medicine is amoxicillin, an antibiotic. Starting today, take one capsule after breakfast, lunch, and dinner for two weeks. Even if your symptoms improve, keep taking it without missing a dose for the full period.

If you develop severe diarrhea or hives, stop taking it and contact your doctor right away. Drink plenty of water while you are taking the medicine. Store the medicine in a cool place out of direct sunlight. Amoxicillin is a type of penicillin, so if you are allergic to penicillin, be sure to tell the pharmacist before taking it.
